title: Incident Reporter
description: Report and triage field incidents — flexible severity and status workflow.

config._note: Single-record archetype: incident is the only companion schema in this template — no child schema references it, no outbound x-openregister-relation, no lifecycle block (status/severity are plain enums). Kept lean per starter-template scope: one full-width data widget with all 7 fields (reportedBy/location/incidentType/severity/description/reportedAt/status; gridHeight 5, ceil(7/2)=4 rows +1 header per ADR-062 sizing heuristic), no stats-block (no child schema exists to aggregate — fabricating a KPI would violate 'never fabricate'), no related panel, no object-list, no content leaves (no file/photo field on the schema — a field incident report with photo evidence would justify a files leaf, but this schema doesn't declare one; adding it would be fabricating a use-case the schema doesn't support). KNOWN GAP: `register` is an unresolved `{{register}}` placeholder — see task report (buildiq#113, placeholder deliberately left as-is here).
